QuestInfo.name: What Pia Borrowed
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p201# has her own reasons for not returning #p218#'s cape.
QuestInfo.1: I went to see #p201# in #m10001000#, and she told me she actually took that red cape because #p218# also hasn't returned some items that she borrowed. She says that she'll return the cape when she gets her things back... The items are #b1 #t4020108##k, #b1 #t4001007##k, and #b30 #t4000039##k.
QuestInfo.2: I paid off #p218#'s debt to #p201# on her behalf and received the #t4031064# in return. Next, all I have to do is bring this back to #p218#.

0.0: Hmm... If you really need this, you should give back the things that #p218# took. Then, I will give the #b#t4031064##k to you.
0.1: How about it? Would you like to pay off her debt and take it with you? Of course, the things #p218# borrowed were all... very precious, you know...

yes.0: Really? You must be really close to #p218#. Anyway, okay. I need #b1 #t4020108##k, #b1 #t4001007##k, and #b30 #t4000039##k. I spent years collecting all these and #p218# just took them!!!
yes.1: Well... If you get me all that, I'll definitely give you the #b#t4031064##k in return. Oh! The #r#o49#s#k probably have the #b#t4001007##k.

no.0: Okay. You don't have to pay the debt, when you weren't even the borrower. Anyway, please tell #p218# that if she wants to get the cape back, she should return the things she took from me.

1.0: M-my things! I thought I'd never see them again! Take the #b#t4031064##k back, as we promised!

item.0: You haven't collected #b1 #t4020108##k, #b1 #t4001007##k, and #b30 #t4000039##k. I will give #p218#'s #b#t4031064##k back to you if you return these things to me!
